items.name: Olive oil

steps: Wash the vegetables and weigh the edible portions.
Chop the tomatoes and unpeeled cucumber. Toss with all the olive oil and divide evenly between two bowls.

items.name: Olive oil
items.edible_description: Salad or cooking oil; weighed in grams

steps: Use cooked, unsalted chickpeas and cooked quinoa, weighed after cooking.
Chop the washed tomatoes. Toss with the chickpeas, quinoa and olive oil, then divide evenly between two bowls.
recipes.origin: ColourFuel development test recipe; not sourced from USDA or CoFID

items.name: Plain whole-milk yoghurt
items.edible_description: Plain whole-milk yoghurt; weighed in grams

steps: Peel the banana and weigh the flesh only. Weigh the plain whole-milk yoghurt and dry chia seeds in grams.
Stir the chia into the yoghurt and allow it to hydrate fully, then add the sliced banana.
recipes.origin: ColourFuel development test recipe; not sourced from USDA or CoFID
recipes.description: Naturally sweet banana, creamy plain yoghurt and a little chia.

items.name: Almonds
items.edible_description: Edible almond kernels, not apricot kernels

steps: Wash the apple, keep the skin and remove the core before weighing. Hull and weigh the strawberries.
Chop the fruit, add the chopped almond kernels and divide evenly between two bowls.
recipes.origin: ColourFuel development test recipe; not sourced from USDA or CoFID
recipes.description: Fresh fruit, a little crunch and a moment to yourself.
